solutions.title: Enumerate split lengths
solutions.strategy: Try all three possible lengths for each of the four address parts.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most 3^4 split patterns are inspected.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion depth and candidate part count are bounded by four.

solutions.title: Backtracking with remaining-length pruning
solutions.strategy: Prune when remaining digits cannot fill the remaining parts.

timeComplexity.explanation: The bounded IPv4 search space is constant, with fewer invalid branches explored.
